h1: The “Furniture” design package and custom furniture manufacturing in Bratislava and Vienna

blocks.text: The “Furniture” design package and custom furniture manufacturing in Bratislava and Vienna

parts.html: “Furniture” is a package for apartments, houses, and commercial spaces where the finishing work is already done and what remains is to design, manufacture, and install custom furniture.
You receive a 3D interior concept and a complete set of furniture drawings — the technical specification for manufacturing kitchens, wardrobes, walk-in closets, and other cabinet furniture.

items: a measured floor plan of the space;

parts.html: The layout shows where the furniture will go, taking into account the room’s dimensions, circulation, ergonomics, and your needs.
Photorealistic 3D visualizations are created for each room, letting you see the future interior and furniture before production even begins.
The price includes one full round of revisions to the concept.
Once the design is approved, we prepare a complete set of furniture drawings: the dimensions, configuration, interior fittings, and construction of each piece.
With these drawings, the furniture can go straight into production.
We design custom cabinet furniture for all the main rooms:

Based on the finished drawings, DUMSKAYA DESIGN can manufacture the furniture at its own production facility, deliver it, and install it. The entire process — from measurements and 3D visualization to manufacturing and installation — is handled within a single project.
Furniture made to custom dimensions is especially helpful in kitchens, built-in wardrobes, and walk-in closets, where every centimeter counts.
We take into account the room’s dimensions, the location of utilities and built-in appliances, the required storage capacity, ergonomics, and the style of the interior.

items: your apartment or house already has its finishes in place;
the property was purchased with a developer’s finish;
the apartment or house needs to be fully furnished;
you need a kitchen and built-in furniture made to custom dimensions;
you want a unified furniture design for all rooms;
you need professional drawings for production.

parts.html: If the renovation is already done, you don’t need a full design project with construction drawings like the one in the “Basic” package.
The final cost depends on the floor area of the property, the number of rooms, the amount of furniture to be designed, and the complexity of the project.
An approved furnishing concept, furniture layout plans, photorealistic 3D visualizations, and a complete set of furniture drawings for production.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN — interior design and bespoke furniture, conceived as one cohesive whole.
